text: /* @component: .custom-select */ document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function (e) {const Selects = [...document.querySelectorAll('.custom-select') ];Selects.forEach(select => { select.addEventListener('click', (e) => clickelect(select, e)) });function clickelect(select, e) {e.stopPropagation(); const target = e.target; var btn = select.querySelector('.dropdown-button'); var span = btn.querySelector('span'); var list = select.querySelector('.dropdown-list'); var items = [...select.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-list__item') ]; var svg = btn.querySelector('svg'); const hidden = select.querySelector('input[type=hidden ]'); const isItem = target.closest('.dropdown-list__item'); if (select.classList.contains('_is-active')) { for (var item of items) { if (isItem && target === item) { select.classList.remove('_is-active'); var v = item.dataset.value; hidden.value = v; span.innerHTML = v; break; } select.classList.remove('_is-active'); } } else { select.classList.add('_is-active'); } } })
